name: dictionnaireduala.com
notes: Resource 1 shared by Achille Mbozeko by email on 2026-11-12 (subject: 'Résultats des recherches sur le hackaton'). Described as an online Duala <-> French dictionary. The host could not be reached from the build environment (network policy), so its structure, licence and reliability have NOT been verified. Run `pnpm ingest --source dictionnaireduala-com --url <page>` once network access is available, after checking the site's terms of use.

name: Glosbe French–Duala dictionary
notes: Resource 2 shared by Achille Mbozeko by email on 2026-11-12. Glosbe is a community-contributed multilingual dictionary platform; entries can be user-submitted and must be treated as unverified. The host could not be reached from the build environment. Glosbe's terms of service restrict automated extraction; manual lookup or an official API agreement is recommended before ingestion.

name: Mboa Sawa – Dictionnaire duala
notes: Resource 3 shared by Achille Mbozeko by email on 2026-11-12. The URL pattern (?lettre=M) suggests an alphabetical Duala–French dictionary browsable letter by letter. Not reachable from the build environment; structure and licence unverified.

name: Kemelang – Duala
notes: Resource 4 shared by Achille Mbozeko by email on 2026-11-12. Appears to be a language-learning / dictionary platform for Cameroonian languages. Not reachable from the build environment; type, structure and licence unverified.

name: Helmlinger, P. (1972). Dictionnaire duala-français, suivi d'un lexique français-duala. Paris: Klincksieck.
license: Copyrighted print work. Only short verified entries may be transcribed with citation; no bulk reproduction.
notes: Standard academic Duala–French dictionary (664 pages) cited by Omniglot, Lexilogos and the Basel Mission Archives. Recommended as the primary reference for linguist verification of entries. Not available in digital form in this project.

name: Ittmann, J., ed. Kähler-Meyer, E. (1976). Wörterbuch der Duala-Sprache / Dictionnaire de la langue duala / Dictionary of the Duala language. Berlin: Dietrich Reimer.
notes: Four-language academic dictionary (675 pages). Reviewers note some missing or erroneous tone marks. Useful secondary reference for linguists.

name: Ittmann, J. (1978). Grammaire du duala (French translation of Grammatik des Duala, 1939). Douala: Collège Libermann.
license: Copyrighted print work. Grammar rules may be summarised in the project's own words with citation.
notes: Reference grammar listed by Glottolog (reference id 80392). Grammar rules entered manually from this work should be recorded with page references in the `reference` field.

name: Wiktionary – Duala lemmas (en.wiktionary.org / fr.wiktionary.org)
notes: Open-licensed community dictionary with a Duala category. Suitable for ingestion as unverified entries with attribution. Not reachable from the build environment; ingest via the MediaWiki API when available.

name: Manual entries by project linguists
license: Project licence (MIT) for entries authored by the project team.
notes: Use this source for vocabulary, expressions and grammar rules typed by native speakers and linguists through the admin interface or the ingest CLI. Entries still start as `pending` and must be approved.
